scope: Browser-side E2EE identity comparison and persistent device-key change warning

controls.algorithm: SHA256 over versioned conversation and canonical device-set commitment

findings.finding: The device-set commitment protected message envelopes but users had no human-comparable identity verification surface.
findings.resolution: The browser now recomputes the canonical device-set commitment and derives a versioned 60-digit safety number for explicit comparison.

findings.finding: A changed device key could otherwise be accepted as ordinary key rotation without user visibility.
findings.resolution: Any observed change preserves the old verified baseline, raises a persistent warning and disables new E2EE sends until explicit reverification.

findings.finding: The first changed-key implementation would have downgraded the warning to unverified after page reload.
findings.resolution: A persisted changePending state keeps the warning fail-closed across reloads and is cleared only by explicit verification of the current commitment.

capacity.reason: Goal reports usageLimited; completed one bounded local packet without a worker
